title: 六级长对话：字幕取舍与小额资助
instruction: 听完整一节两段长对话及各段后读出的问题，依次选择最佳答案。音频中材料和问题各读一遍，卷面只印四个选项。本原创使用节内编号1—8，各段对应1—4、5—8题。播放器可回听，正式单次听辨条件未强制。
audio_introduction: Section A. You will hear two long conversations. After each, you will hear questions. Each recording and each question will be spoken only once. Choose the best answer from A, B, C and D.
source_form_notice: 六级形式参照2024年12月第一套转载Section A：2段、4/4共8回应、每题四选；原创采用节内编号，问题只在录音与作者区。全部自有虚构内容及本机合成试听，非原考试原声；未独立教研/听辨/学生难度或产品等值验证。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Our student podcast is adding video, and I have been asked to prepare the subtitles. I thought I could simply use the automatic transcript, but the producer wants me to edit it.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The transcript is a starting point. People repeat themselves when speaking, and the viewer has limited time to read. Editing does not mean changing their position; it means deciding which repetitions can disappear without removing a qualification.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That is what worries me. One guest says a new scheme will probably help, and then adds that it depends on how it is introduced. If I keep only the first part, the subtitle looks much more confident.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Keep the condition. Remove an empty restart if you need space, but do not exchange a cautious claim for a promise. We can also divide a long contribution across two subtitle screens.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The producer suggested putting an explanation of the scheme underneath at the same time. Would that solve the problem?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It might overload the screen. The subtitle is carrying what the guest says. Background information could appear on a separate card before the interview, clearly marked as the editorial introduction.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: So the two kinds of text should not look as if they came from the same speaker. I also have a name I cannot catch in the recording.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Ask the producer to check it against the guest list. Do not choose the nearest familiar name just because the software supplies one. Leave a query in the working file until it is confirmed.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We are due to publish on Thursday. I could finish the easy parts today and send the uncertain name with its time in the recording.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That would be useful. I can review the condition we discussed and the layout tomorrow. After that, we should watch the video with the sound off to check whether the text can actually be followed.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I will send a draft rather than call the transcript finished. It is a different task from merely producing every word the microphone recorded.

questions.spoken_question: What does the man say editing the subtitles should preserve?
options: Every empty restart in the speech.
The qualifications that limit a speaker’s claim.
Only the strongest promise in each answer.
The automatic software’s choice of names.
questions.rationale: B保留条件限制；A空重启可删，C不可把谨慎变保证，D姓名需核不信自动。

questions.spoken_question: Why does the man question adding background text under the subtitles?
options: The background scheme has been cancelled.
The guest has refused all subtitles.
The two languages use identical words.
Too much simultaneous text may overload the screen.
questions.rationale: D屏幕同时字幕背景会overload；A/B/C未述。

questions.spoken_question: What does the man recommend for the unclear name?
options: Checking it against information about the guests.
Selecting the most familiar software suggestion.
Removing the whole interview from the programme.
Printing every possible name on the screen.
questions.rationale: A询制作人据名单核；B明确反，C/D未建议且不解决确认。

questions.spoken_question: What will they do after reviewing the draft layout?
options: Replace the guest’s condition with a shorter promise.
Watch the video without sound to test readability.
Record all the background text as the guest’s words.
questions.rationale: C下一步无声看是否跟上文本；A/D改变归属反，B非预定处理。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I am applying for the small community research grant. The maximum award would cover our whole project, but I am not sure how to present the budget.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Separate the essential work from optional additions. The panel needs to see what can still be done if it offers less than the maximum. Otherwise, a reduced award looks as if it would leave the proposal impossible.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The essential part is interviewing former shopkeepers. We also want a printed booklet, although that could wait. Should I list the booklet as if it were included in every version?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. Explain the smaller project honestly. You could prepare an online account with the interviews and a clear record of permission, then seek printing funds later. Do not promise a booklet that a smaller award cannot support.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We have a volunteer who can design it without payment. I was going to count that as cash already secured.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Describe it as a promised contribution of time, with its conditions. It is valuable, but it is not money you can spend on travel or printing. The panel should be able to distinguish those resources.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We also need permission from participants. Is it enough to say that anyone agreeing to an interview has agreed to publication?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Those are different decisions. Your proposal should explain how you will ask about recording and public use separately. A person may be willing to talk while wanting a particular story kept private.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That will make the procedure longer. The application form allows an attachment, so I could outline it there rather than squeeze everything into the budget box.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Exactly. Use the budget for costs and the attachment for the method. Before submission, ask the volunteer to confirm how much time she can offer. A contribution should not become certain merely because it looks useful in a form.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will revise the essential version first, then confirm her offer and write the permission procedure. The larger booklet can remain a clearly labelled possibility.

questions.spoken_question: Why should the man describe an essential version of the project?
options: To hide the real travel costs.
To make every optional addition compulsory.
To show what a smaller award could still support.
To avoid explaining any method to the panel.
questions.rationale: C减额仍能做什么；A隐瞒非、B反、D另附件讲方法。

questions.spoken_question: How should the volunteer’s offer be described?
options: As a conditional contribution of time.
As proof that no budget is needed.
As a payment already received from the panel.
questions.rationale: A时间贡献需核条件；B不能花作现金，C仍差旅印费，D尚申请。

questions.spoken_question: What distinction does the woman make about participants?
options: Only paid participants can refuse a question.
Every interview must be printed in full.
Agreeing to talk is separate from agreeing to public use.
questions.rationale: D交谈/录制公开分别问；A/B/C无此规则且反隐私条件。

questions.spoken_question: What does the woman advise the man to confirm before submission?
options: The exact sales price of a completed booklet.
The amount of time the volunteer can actually offer.
The names of all future grant-panel members.
The date when every shopkeeper will retire.
questions.rationale: B确认义工可给时间；A印册可后置，C/D未要求。
